scope: MEAS: independent numerical, report/source, published bar-map and visual review; not aural review.

report.finding: The report agrees with final gates, 3173 notes / five source parts, pickup-plus-82-bar order and six-page pack. The wrong earlier 205.460913 s final-pitch candidate is explicitly rejected; the published final attack is 209.260457 s.

barMap.finding: All 3173 note bar/voice indices resolve, durations are positive and bar times strictly increase. Actual SVG/index bar sets agree exactly: eighth-note pickup 0, then 1–82. Rendered pages 1 and 6 were inspected, including the real pickup and closing half-note fermata. Listen cues use seconds, not structured bar pointers.

overlays.finding: No gross pitch/order mismatch identified. The genuine final E-major arrival follows the intervening dominant/trill/pause instead of collapsing the cadence. The extra adjacent-pitch diagnostic resolves an apparent global-overlay floor problem: E2 remains far above its neighbouring semitone bands well after 210.6 s, with weaker G-sharp4/E5 also continuing. Therefore truncating at the global image's visual floor would remove real source-pitched resonance; the retained 213.78 s estimated display end is not evidence of a four-and-a-half-second physical bow hold.
overlays.decayMeasurementQualification: MEAS: The diagnostic plots cached feature amplitudes relative to a fixed reference, not calibrated sound-pressure levels. VerS inspected the curves but did not independently recompute their dB values.

version.finding: Complete first movement: pickup 0 and 1–82 once. Refrains/echoes are written out, not extra traversals. All five source string/bass staves are retained without fabricated realised continuo. No gross musical cut or arrangement mismatch identified. The listen module explicitly qualifies the recording's conflicting source/embedded attribution; this review does not resolve ensemble identity.
version.physicalPerformingEdition: Unknown; the symbolic-source edition is not asserted to identify the recording's physical parts.

limitations: MEAS: No aural review, build or browser integration check performed by VerS. The middle anchor is close to the 0.5 s gate, and P95 exceeds the median gate; passing does not establish uniformly exact onsets. Written durations warped to an estimated decay end are not measured releases.
